faqs.q: What are Enerpac DSX aluminium square drive hydraulic torque wrenches used for?
faqs.a: Enerpac DSX wrenches are lightweight aluminium square-drive hydraulic torque wrenches for tightening and loosening large bolts, with five models from 1,411 to 24,057 ft-lbs. Each needs a 10,000 psi pump and twin hose; see the [hydraulic torque wrenches shelf](/c/hydraulic-torque-wrenches).

faqs.q: How do I read the Enerpac DSX part numbers?
faqs.a: The number after DSX is the nominal size, and the rows give the real torque: DSX1500 is 1,411 ft-lbs and DSX3000 is 3,233 ft-lbs. DSX5000 is 5,635 ft-lbs, DSX11000 is 11,524 ft-lbs and DSX25000 is 24,057 ft-lbs.

faqs.q: Which square drive sizes do the Enerpac DSX wrenches have?
faqs.a: The drives are 3/4 in (DSX1500), 1 in (DSX3000), 1 1/2 in (DSX5000 and DSX11000) and 2 1/2 in (DSX25000). Match the drive to your impact socket.

faqs.q: What torque range do the Enerpac DSX wrenches cover?
faqs.a: They cover 1,411, 3,233, 5,635, 11,524 and 24,057 ft-lbs across the five models. Choose a wrench whose maximum torque is above the bolt torque with margin.

faqs.q: What pump and hose do the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches need?
faqs.a: Hydraulic torque wrenches such as the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches need a 10,000 psi pump and twin hose, so the pump, hose and couplers must all be rated for that pressure. The listing has 5 part numbers, for example DSX11000, DSX1500 and DSX25000.

faqs.q: Does Indus supply calibration or test documents for the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches?
faqs.a: No calibration certificate or approval is listed for the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches. If your job needs a calibration or test report, state it on your [request](/contact) and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What accessories go with the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches?
faqs.a: The Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches work with a 10,000 psi pump, twin hose, and the sockets or cassettes for your nut size; see the [Enerpac pump range](/c/hydraulic-torque-wrenches) and the [low profile cassettes](/p/enerpac-low-profile-hydraulic-torque-wrenches). Quote the model and nut size.

faqs.q: How do I size the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches for a bolt?
faqs.a: Size a torque wrench on the bolt torque first, then on the clearance around the nut: square-drive wrenches take impact sockets, and low-profile hexagon wrenches fit where a socket will not. For the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches, check the torque against the list of part numbers such as DSX3000 and DSX5000.

faqs.q: Where are the Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac DSX Aluminium Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches are used on flanged joints, heavy machinery and structural bolting where manual torque is not practical. Browse the [hydraulic torque wrenches](/c/hydraulic-torque-wrenches) for other wrench types.

faqs.q: How does the aluminium DSX compare with the steel S-series wrench?
faqs.a: The DSX is aluminium and runs from 1,411 to 24,057 ft-lbs, while the [S-series](/p/enerpac-s-series-square-drive-hydraulic-torque-wrenches) is square drive in 1,440 to 26,150 ft-lbs with an optional Pro Series swivel. Choose the DSX when weight matters.
